info.description:
## Training Collection

This collection is a hands-on reference for working with a content management API. It is organized into folders by content type, each containing requests to list all records or retrieve a specific one by its Document ID.

### Content

| Folder | Requests |
|---|---|
| **Article** | All Articles, Article by Document ID |
| **Category** | All Categories, Category by Document ID |
| **Tag** | All Tags, Tag by Document ID |
| **Product** | All Products, Product by Document ID |
| **Company Profile** | Company Profile |

### Environment

Use the **Training** environment to supply the required variables:

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `API_BASE_URL` | Base URL for all API requests |
| `ARTICLE_DOCUMENT_ID` | ID of a specific article to fetch |
| `CATEGORIES_DOCUMENT_ID` | ID of a specific category to fetch |
| `TAG_DOCUMENT_ID` | ID of a specific tag to fetch |
| `PRODUCT_DOCUMENT_ID` | ID of a specific product to fetch |

request.description:
## Create Career

Creates a new career/job posting entry in the system.

**Method:** `POST`
**URL:** `{{API_BASE_URL}}/careers`
**Authentication:** Bearer Token

---

### Request Body

The request body must be sent as JSON with the following structure:

```json
{
    "data": {
        "position": "Backend Developer",
        "slug": "backend-developer",
        "location": "Jakarta",
        "employment_type": "FULL_TIME",
        "description": [...rich text...],
        "requirements": [...rich text...],
        "responsibilities": [...rich text...],
        "is_active": true
    }
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `position` | String | The job title or position name (e.g., `"Backend Developer"`). |
| `slug` | String | A URL-friendly identifier for the career post (e.g., `"backend-developer"`). |
| `location` | String | The work location for the position (e.g., `"Jakarta"`). |
| `employment_type` | String | The type of employment. Accepted values: `FULL_TIME`, `PART_TIME`, `CONTRACT`, `INTERNSHIP`, etc. |
| `description` | Rich Text Array | A detailed description of the job role, formatted as a rich text array. |
| `requirements` | Rich Text Array | A list of qualifications and requirements for the position, formatted as a rich text array. |
| `responsibilities` | Rich Text Array | A list of duties and responsibilities for the role, formatted as a rich text array. |
| `is_active` | Boolean | Indicates whether the career posting is currently active and visible. Set to `true` to publish. |

---

### Response

**Status:** `201 Created`

Returns the newly created career object wrapped in a `data` field, along with a `meta` object.

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `id` | Auto-incremented numeric ID of the career entry. |
| `documentId` | Unique string identifier for the document. |
| `position` | The job title as provided in the request. |
| `slug` | The URL-friendly slug as provided in the request. |
| `location` | The work location as provided in the request. |
| `employment_type` | The employment type as provided in the request. |
| `description` | The rich text description content. |
| `requirements` | The rich text requirements content. |
| `responsibilities` | The rich text responsibilities content. |
| `is_active` | Boolean indicating if the posting is active. |
| `expired_at` | Expiration date of the posting. `null` if not set. |
| `createdAt` | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the record was created. |
| `updatedAt` | ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update. |
| `publishedAt` | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the record was published. |
| `meta` | Additional metadata object (empty `{}` by default). |
